exposure: Late preterm birth (34 (0/7) and 36 (6/7) weeks gestation)
Late preterm infants born at 35 weeks gestation
Late preterm infants born before 35 weeks gestation
cohort: 214 late preterm infants eligible for rooming-in
finding: Early first latch-on and immediate skin-to-skin contact were significantly associated with exclusive human milk feeding.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean sections were more likely to have non-exclusive breastfeeding compared to those who did not.
